amendments.title: Support: Send message hidden behind the iPhone keyboard
amendments.what: Smoke test 2026-09-19 (iPhone 16, Expo Go): with the cursor in 'Your message' the keyboard covers Send. The 2026-09-16 fix made Send reachable by scrolling but never brought it into view.
amendments.fix: ScrollView ref + scrollToEnd when the keyboard shows while the message box has focus (and on focus if the keyboard is already up). Android unproven: emulator soft keyboard was off.

amendments.title: Android: bottom nav rides on top of the keyboard
amendments.what: Pixel 7 (API 34), Support message box: Android resizes the window, so the bottom nav sits above the keys and eats typing room. On the iPhone the keyboard covers it.
amendments.fix: BottomNav returns null on Android while the keyboard is up (keyboardDidShow/Hide). iOS untouched. Header comment names the divergence.
